name: Mfuwe International Airport
before:
The airport for South Luangwa. It serves Mfuwe, a scattered settlement in Mambwe District in Zambia's Eastern Province, and it exists almost entirely for the safari trade built around South Luangwa National Park and the other wildlife areas of the Luangwa Valley.

It is one of only four international airports in Zambia, a status it was given in 1995, and the international flights it does take are seasonal, which matters a great deal when planning a safari itinerary. Check what is actually flying for the client's travel dates rather than assuming a year round service.

There is a single runway, at an elevation of 1,853 feet.
after:
The airport for South Luangwa National Park, serving Mfuwe and the park's safari lodges and camps.

It is one of only four international airports in Zambia, a status it was given in 1995. Proflight Zambia flies here from Lusaka. Check what is flying on the client's travel dates rather than assuming a set pattern: in September 2026 Proflight's timetable showed two flights a day each way until 31 October and fewer from November.

There is a single runway, at an elevation of 1,853 feet.

claims.inAfter: in September 2026 Proflight's timetable showed two flights a day each way until 31 October and fewer from November
claims.note: Attributed statement, checked against Proflight's own timetables for its own flights, read on 23 September 2026 (hence 'in September 2026'). Lusaka to Mfuwe: P0 804 and P0 808 daily until 31 October (14 a week); in November P0 800, 804 and 808 on set days (9 a week); from 1 December to 3 January 804 and 808 on set days (7 a week). Mfuwe to Lusaka mirrors it (P0 805 and 809 daily until 31 October). It carries the old text's point that the service is not the same all year.

claims.claim: the international flights it does take are seasonal
claims.wasBefore: and the international flights it does take are seasonal, which matters a great deal when planning a safari itinerary
claims.why: Could not be confirmed as current. Proflight's timetable from Mfuwe has only Lusaka flights (with connections beyond); the operator's undated airport page mentions direct flights to Lilongwe, and its 2025 report counts only 874 international passengers of 33,235 at Mfuwe that year, with no route named. The Ulendo Airlink schedule Wikipedia cites was at flyulendo.com, which is now a hijacked gambling site. Replaced by who flies now (Proflight from Lusaka) and the timetable's seasonal pattern.

claims.claim: check what is flying rather than assuming a year round service
claims.wasBefore: Check what is actually flying for the client's travel dates rather than assuming a year round service.
claims.why: Reworded, not removed: the advice now follows from Proflight's own timetable, which changes month by month.

Held back: replaces nothing in the old text, and rests on the operator's 2025 annual report alone (Wikipedia gives no figure). 33,235 passengers in 2025, 32,361 domestic and 874 international; 1.36 per cent of the ZACL network.

claims.claim: Held back: runway rebuilding due March 2027
claims.why: Held back: new, replaces nothing, and rests on the operator's 2025 annual report alone. The runway, taxiway and apron are being rebuilt under a design-and-build contract, with the existing runway to become a taxiway; 10 per cent done at the end of 2025, completion scheduled for March 2027. Worth re-checking for disruption before the dry season of 2027.
